provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Le Havre rules (Lookout Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: 3 game boards side by side: Treasury left, Building Proposals center, Ship spaces right

steps.note: Shortened version: 4/8/12/12/15 rounds, with different starting goods and no Special buildings

steps.text: Shuffle the 7 Supply tiles facedown onto the round spaces
Goods, food and Franc tokens on their Supply spaces, standard side up
Starting offers: 2 Francs, 2 fish, 2 wood and 1 clay on their Offer spaces
Shuffle the Special buildings; 6 facedown on their space, box the rest
Each player: a Person disc, a Ship marker and a Game turn overview card
Ship markers beside the first board, near the first Supply tile
Each player starts with {f} Francs and {c} coal
The player who lives closest to water takes the Starting player tile; play is clockwise
